Java Backend Development Course with Spring Boot, Microservices & AI Tools

Live Course
438k+ interested Geeks

The Java Backend Development course is a 12-week live, mentor-led programme covering core and advanced Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, MySQL and JPA, Redis caching, Spring Security, microservices and Kafka. It is built for developers who already know Java basics and want production backend skills. You build three portfolio projects - a Splitwise-style expense-sharing app, an AI-agent-assisted extension of it, and an Airbnb-style rental platform and earn an IBM & GeeksforGeeks certificate.

Projects You'll Build

Real-world projects to apply your skills

Splitwise Backend

Build a Splitwise-like Expense Sharing Application from the ground up project environment setup, technical architecture design, project flowchart, expense creation and settlement flows, user and group management features, HLSD, and data modeling concepts.

Splitwise with Cursor AI Agents

Enhance the Splitwise backend with advanced capabilities integrate JUnit testing and Redis caching, add Spring Security with role-based access, implement advanced validations, and use AI Agents in Cursor to automate repetitive backend code tasks.

Airbnb Backend System

Build and deploy an Airbnb-like Property Rental Platform HLSD, data modeling for users, properties, bookings and payments, scalable microservices architecture, Spring Cloud Gateway routing, containerized deployment, monitoring, logging, and production readiness.

Course Syllabus

Java Backend Development Course with Spring Boot, Microservices & AI Tools
AI Toolkit for Developers

Session 1: Java Architecture and Basics of OOPs

  • Introduction to Java architecture
  • Learn the basics of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Understand core OOP principles

Session 2: Advanced Java Concepts

  • Compare Abstract Classes and Interfaces
  • Understand the Java Exception Hierarchy
  • Role of the finally block and throw keyword
  • Understand exception propagation
  • Introduction of Singleton Design Pattern

Session 3: Java 8 Functional Programming & Collections Overview

  • Lambda Expressions and Functional Interfaces
  • Use built-in functional interfaces
  • Overview of the Java Collections Framework
  • Introduction to Queues

Session 4: Java Advanced Features

  • Understand Generics in Java
  • Work with the Streams API and HashMap
  • Learn the Hashing Algorithms
  • Differentiate between Sequential and Parallel Streams
Read more

1: The AI Toolkit & Developer Setup

  • Map of AI tools: LLMs, code assistants, AI search, agents
  • Tool categories: chat models, IDE copilots, CLI agents
  • Evaluation framework: accuracy, context window, cost, latency
  • When AI helps vs. when it hurts: real limitations
  • Setting up an AI-powered dev environment in 30 minutes
  • Live experiment: solving the same problem with multiple tools

2: Prompt Engineering & Vibe Coding

  • Vibe coding: natural language to code (fast prototyping)
  • Anatomy of a developer prompt: role, context, task, constraints
  • Zero-shot to few-shot escalation strategy
  • Chain-of-thought prompting for better reasoning
  • Iterative prompting and fixing hallucinations

3: Spec-Driven Development with AI

  • Transition from prompts to structured specifications
  • Writing clear technical specs before code generation
  • Few-shot prompting with real codebase patterns
  • Generating reliable code aligned with requirements
  • Reducing ambiguity and improving determinism

4: RAG Systems & Context-Aware AI

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals
  • Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search
  • Connecting AI to codebases, docs, and internal data
  • Building developer assistants using RAG
  • Limitations and failure modes of RAG systems
